open_points.subject: execute_function process-count enforcement
open_points.text: the outer process bound is the setrlimit limit on the number of processes at bounds.process_count + 1, set by the runner inside the sandbox's user namespace before it loads the code, soft and hard alike
open_points.other_text: process_count bounds the tasks of the code alive at once: the runner's main thread counts as the first, every live thread and every process the code forked with os.fork counts with its threads, and bubblewrap's own processes are not counted
open_points.question: Which passage must change? Setting RLIMIT_NPROC inside the new user namespace does not make its accounting namespace-local: it still accounts tasks for the host real user, including unrelated host tasks, so it cannot be the stated outer bound over only the code's tasks.
